##### Project general facts

Westwood Grande II by Imtiaz is a stunning new residential tower that brings a fresh sense of elegance and everyday comfort to modern living. Conceived by an award-winning French architect, the building is wrapped in a string of softly curved balconies arranged in a beautiful wavy pattern, creating a facade that is a true visual spectacle. Residents can choose from a thoughtfully designed collection of studios and one-bedroom apartments, each offering generous living areas, gourmet kitchens and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Life here is enriched by a wonderful array of five-star amenities created for wellness, connection and togetherness. A spectacular rooftop infinity pool and a fully equipped rooftop gym with the latest equipment invite residents to relax and stay active high above the city, while lush green gardens offer the perfect place to unwind or begin the day with a positive mindset. Families will love the dedicated kids play area and the inviting BBQ zone, and every guest is welcomed through an elegant landscaped lobby that sets a five-star tone from the very first step.

The interiors are curated by an award-winning interior designer to deliver an elegant, sophisticated and effortlessly luxurious living experience. Sleek, modern homes come equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and luxe finishes, and the colour schemes are inspired by nature to create a tranquil and calming atmosphere. Rich materials are used throughout, from marble-look kitchen tiles and refined wood veneer to soft wallpapers, plush area rugs, premium upholstery and delicate rose gold accents that reflect real quality and finesse.

##### Location description and benefits 

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
